terrain_reading_convention.reference_operation: dem = load(file); dem = dem'; dem = dem(:); elev = dem(sub2ind([ny,nx], y_idx, x_idx));
terrain_reading_convention.matrix_orientation: first matrix dimension is x; second matrix dimension is y

coordinate_mapping.index_formula: round(coordinate_km / domain_km * (n - 1)) + 1 in MATLAB; use zero-based index after conversion in Python
coordinate_mapping.rounding: MATLAB round to the nearest grid node; for the positive coordinates used here, floor(value + 0.5) is equivalent

terrain_reading_convention.interpolation_policy: The audited MATLAB half-space profile uses nearest-grid sampling. Bilinear interpolation is allowed only for explicitly labeled A16 path-profile diagnostics and must preserve the same x-first/y-second orientation.
applies_to: A16/S12 packaged and external topography grids
all derived elevation, slope, path-relief, depression, and terrain-correlation calculations

terrain_sampling_rule.index_rule: Load text grid; MATLAB transpose plus column-major flatten plus sub2ind([ny,nx], y_idx, x_idx), equivalent to raw[x_idx, y_idx] in NumPy for this square grid
terrain_sampling_rule.rounding: Nearest grid node using MATLAB round; do not use bilinear interpolation for the audited profile

low_velocity_extension.audit_note: M5 and M6 contain the same r1-r606 names and sequence numbers as M1-M4. Their records extend to approximately 400 s, whereas M1-M4 end at approximately 250 s. Cross-generation effects must use the common 50-245 s window; 245-395 s diagnostics are descriptive only for M5/M6. No run-local model manifest accompanied the two output-only folders, so exact low-velocity-layer parameters and source identity remain to be confirmed before parameter inversion. Low-velocity/no-heterogeneity cells are unavailable, so a full topography x heterogeneity x low-velocity factorial design and a low-velocity x heterogeneity interaction cannot be estimated.
